description: So this is Shuuhei`s girlfriend Hitomi-chan. She`s really nice and pretty eh? All-right, I`ll help bring you two together. All of a sudden Hitomi-chan`s older brother shows up. "Judo`s eighth rank, karate`s ninth rank, third-level abacus??" H... huh? Where did I heard that before...?

titles.title: 小さな恋の狂詩曲(ラプソディー)
